description.la: Benjamin major, sive De gratia contemplationis, in quinque libris: arca mystica et sex genera contemplationis.
description.en-US: Richard’s Grace of Contemplation in five books: the ark of the covenant as the figure of contemplation, its six kinds and the ecstasy of the mind above itself. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 196, 1855), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A Graça da contemplação de Ricardo em cinco livros: a arca da aliança como figura da contemplação, os seus seis gêneros e o êxtase do espírito acima de si mesmo.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 196 (Paris 1855); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text RiSVi.BenMaj, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
